title: HUMT DUMT: Measuring and controlling human-like language in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the SOCIOT metric by calculating the log-likelihood ratio of LLM-generated text when conditioned on feminine pronouns (e.g., 'She said') versus masculine pronouns (e.g., 'He said') to evaluate if human-like outputs rely on stereotypically feminine language.

Measured using the SOCIOT metric by calculating the relative probability of text conditioned on high-power/high-status verbs (e.g., 'commanded', 'demanded') versus low-power/low-status verbs (e.g., 'pleaded', 'asked') to evaluate power dynamics and subservient roles in LLM personas.
